title: dont auto dismiss status announce complete
rule: Don’t auto-dismiss status; if the message is time-bound, announce completion — “uploading…” may vanish when done and a live region must say “upload complete.” Dual-cite Spectrum toast ≥5s / Suomi 10s; no house seconds.
pass_when: Status that is still relevant stays; time-bound status that vanishes is replaced by a live-region completion announcement.
fail_when: Status auto-dismisses with no completion announcement.
overview: Do not auto-dismiss relevant status; announce completion in a live region when time-bound status vanishes.
apply_when: Showing progress or status messages that may expire when work finishes.
not_when: Not for static help text that is not a status announcement.
agent_hint: Keep relevant status; if it vanishes, announce completion in a live region.
description: Do not auto-dismiss status that is still relevant. If a time-bound message such as “uploading…” vanishes when done, a live region must announce completion—for example “upload complete.” Silent disappearance leaves people unsure whether the work finished. Fail when status auto-dismisses with no completion announcement. Apply to progress and status messages that may expire when work finishes.
do_not_claim: A house toast duration; Suomi toast geometry as this live-region row.
